features: Screenless activity tracker for 24/7 heart rate, steps, distance, calories, active zone minutes, sleep and supported health metrics.
Up to 7 days of battery life with a rechargeable 34.5 mAh lithium-ion battery; full charging takes about 90 minutes.
Lightweight tracker body measures 34.9 x 17 x 8.3 mm and weighs about 5.2 g without the band, approximately 12 g with the band.
Water resistant to 50 metres and designed for continuous day-and-night wear, including workouts and sleep tracking.
Works with compatible Android and iOS smartphones through Bluetooth and the Google Health app.
Special Edition Pokemon Sleep in Sleepy Blue supports syncing sleep duration and sleep stages with the Pokemon Sleep app.
description: Google Fitbit Air is a screenless fitness and health activity tracker designed for continuous wear. It tracks heart rate, steps, active zone minutes, distance, calories burned, sleep and supported health metrics using an optical heart-rate sensor, 3-axis accelerometer and gyroscope, red and infrared sensors for SpO2 monitoring, and a device temperature sensor. The tracker provides up to 7 days of battery life, is water resistant to 50 metres, and syncs over Bluetooth with compatible Android and iOS smartphones using Google Health. This Special Edition Pokemon Sleep model in Sleepy Blue can sync supported sleep data with the Pokemon Sleep app and features a Sleeping Pikachu band detail.
